_comment: Settings of the emtk H2MM app: AutoForm over H2mmViewModel. Same controls as the Qt tool's Settings tab (model selection, optimisation, decoder) plus the detector streams of its Channels tab as routing-channel lists.

sections.description: Burst folder and the donor, acceptor and acceptor-excitation detectors.
sections.title: Data

sections.label: Burst folder
sections.description: Folder with the burst (.bur) tables of a finished burst analysis, or a measurement .pto container; the photons they name are read from beside them (a container holds them).

sections.title: Runs
sections.description: The analyses stored in the container; pick the one the next step reads.

columns.title: Run
columns.tooltip: The analysis' name inside the container; the settings are part of it.

columns.title: Operation
columns.tooltip: What produced the burst table of this run.

columns.title: Algorithm
columns.tooltip: The estimator or search that produced it, when recorded.

columns.title: Rows
columns.tooltip: Rows in the run's burst table.

columns.title: Settings
columns.tooltip: Hash of the run's settings: the same settings always give the same one.

columns.title: Order
columns.tooltip: Position in the container's write order; the last one is the newest.

sections.label: Donor detector
sections.description: Detector of the donor photons (stream 0): apparent FRET E = A/(A+D). Define detectors in the Detector setup window.

sections.label: Acceptor detector
sections.description: Detector of the acceptor photons (stream 1). Swapping donor and acceptor still converges and looks plausible: check the assignment.

sections.label: Aex detector
sections.description: Optional third stream (usALEX / PIE): acceptor photons under acceptor excitation. Gives every state a stoichiometry.
Range of state numbers tried and the information criterion that picks the best.
sections.title: Model selection

sections.label: Min states
sections.description: Smallest number of states tried.

sections.label: Max states
sections.description: Largest number of states tried.

sections.label: Criterion
sections.description: Information criterion that picks the state count: BIC, or ICL which also penalises overlapping states.

sections.label: Scan patience
sections.description: Stop the state-count scan once the criterion has risen this many times (about 1.6 times faster); -1 fits every state count.
EM engine, restarts, iterations and photon thresholds of the H2MM fit.
sections.title: Optimisation

sections.label: Engine
sections.description: Compute engine: fast float32 EM (default), exact float64 EM, or the neural surrogate (fastest, approximate).

sections.label: Restarts
sections.description: Random initialisations per state count; the best log-likelihood wins.

sections.label: Seed
sections.description: Seed of the restarts: the same seed refits to the same answer.

sections.label: Max iterations
sections.description: Maximum EM iterations per fit.

sections.label: Min photons / burst
sections.description: Bursts with fewer stream photons are left out.

sections.label: Macro-time scale
sections.description: Integer down-scaling of macro times (coarser base unit); raise it when the fit is slow.

sections.label: Nanotime divisors
sections.description: Split each stream into this many micro-time bins so states of equal E but different lifetime separate; 1 is off.
Optional exports: photon table, decoded state paths and state photons.
sections.title: Output

sections.label: Photon table HDF5
sections.description: Write h2mm_photons.h5: compact and fast to reload.

sections.label: Photon table CSV
sections.description: Write h2mm_photons.csv: what every other tool can open.

sections.label: Decoder
sections.description: How one state is assigned per photon: Viterbi (most likely path), jitter (draw per photon) or ffbs (draw whole paths).

sections.label: Decoder seed
sections.description: Seed of the sampling decoders.

sections.label: Write state photons
sections.description: Write the decoded assignment back beside each source measurement.

sections.label: State photons as PTU
sections.description: A PTU whose routing channels encode (stream, state).

sections.label: State photons sidecar
sections.description: A msgpack sidecar; the source file is left untouched.
Fitted transition rates between states in 1/s.
sections.title: Rates

columns.label: k [1/s]
columns.description: Fitted transition rate (one-step probability divided by the base time). '< x' is a transition the fit did not see: its rate sits at the numerical floor x and is only a bound.

columns.label: 1/k [ms]
columns.description: Mean waiting time for that transition.

sections.description: Fitted state efficiencies, stoichiometries and populations.
sections.title: States

columns.label: E
columns.description: Apparent FRET efficiency E = A/(A+D) of the state (no leakage, direct excitation or gamma correction).

columns.label: Occupancy
columns.description: Photon fraction of the state from the per-photon posterior (the unbiased estimate; falls back to the decoded path).

sections.description: Burst inspected in the result plots.
sections.title: Burst

sections.label: Burst
sections.description: Index into the bursts listed for the state-path plot (all bursts, or only those with a decoded transition).

sections.label: Dynamic bursts only
sections.description: List only bursts with at least one decoded transition.
